registration_timing: Before implementation of the CMLE-WLE Person MnSq kernel, cross-engine fixture generation, or inspection of its numerical results.
purpose: Validate fixed-calibration Person Infit/Outfit MnSq for the exact-CMLE plus Warm-WLE fit sample before adding fit-zone transitions to bootstrap evidence or exposing output in Streamlit.

estimand_contract.population: Persons and administered rows retained in the inference-ready exact-CMLE fit sample.
estimand_contract.calibration: Exact-CMLE structural coefficients treated as fixed.
estimand_contract.person_measure: The validated fixed-calibration Warm WLE for each retained Person.
estimand_contract.category_probability: softmax(q_uk(beta_hat) + k * theta_hat_p) over declared categories k, with q from the fitted CMLE row design.
estimand_contract.observation_residual: observed internal category minus its fitted expected internal category.
estimand_contract.observation_variance: fitted variance of the internal category under the same probability kernel.
estimand_contract.outfit_mnsq: weighted mean of residual squared divided by observation variance.
estimand_contract.infit_mnsq: weighted sum of residual squared divided by weighted sum of observation variance.
estimand_contract.fourth_central_moment: retained for later transformation research but not used to publish ZSTD in this phase.
estimand_contract.sirt_parameter_map: For each virtual response unit and internal category k > 0, sirt pcm.fit cumulative category difficulty b_k equals -q_k; b_0 is implicit zero.
estimand_contract.treatment_of_extremes: Retain exact minimum/maximum response patterns because Warm WLE is finite; label their score-pattern status explicitly.
estimand_contract.treatment_of_missingness: Use only administered rows retained by CMLE; do not impute or convert missing rows to scores.
estimand_contract.weights: Require finite positive observation weights. Exact-CMLE Phase 0 currently admits only its validated unit-weight interpretation.
estimand_contract.variance_failure: Fail closed for a Person if any included fitted variance or derived ratio is non-finite or non-positive; never coerce the contribution to zero.

reference_comparison_contract.primary: sirt::pcm.fit personfit computed from the identical wide virtual-unit response matrix, identical fixed WLE theta, and b_k=-q_k.
reference_comparison_contract.primary_reason: sirt::pcm.fit directly implements untrimmed fixed-theta PCM Person Infit/Outfit with the same residual and variance definitions.
reference_comparison_contract.secondary_non_equivalence: TAM::tam.jml.fit trims unusually large observation squared-standardized residuals before Outfit aggregation using trim_val times the global SD. It is therefore not an unconditional row-for-row parity target for untrimmed Outfit.
reference_comparison_contract.wle_estimator_warning: Passing TAM WLEs into TAM JML fit machinery or sirt pcm.fit evaluates fit at fixed WLE theta; it does not turn the CMLE structural calibration into JMLE or MML.

withheld_outputs.ZSTD: Withheld: finite-sample distribution, effective degrees of freedom, trimming, and extreme-pattern behavior have not been validated for this CMLE plus WLE estimand.
withheld_outputs.p_value: Withheld: no validated null reference distribution in this phase.
withheld_outputs.confidence_interval: Withheld: bootstrap coverage has not been qualified.
withheld_outputs.total_standard_error: Withheld: conditional WLE information and CMLE/bootstrap calibration variation are not interchangeable variance components.
withheld_outputs.public_fit_zone_transitions: Withheld until the parity gate passes and a new immutable bootstrap fit-extension run is completed.
withheld_outputs.streamlit_output: Withheld until research evidence and first-read status contracts pass.

bootstrap_extension_contract.baseline_and_every_inference_ready_refit: Compute Person Infit/Outfit from that replicate's refitted exact-CMLE calibration and refitted Warm WLE.
